# intutic_notification_rule <Badge type="tip" text="Cloud" />

A notification rule (`/api/v1/notifications/rules`): which event goes to which Slack channel, email addresses, webhook or PagerDuty service. Each channel needs its own target attribute. A webhook rule is always signed; its signing secret is generated by the API, returned once and kept in state as `signing_secret`; `secret_rotation_triggers` replaces it. Needs an OWNER or ADMIN key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "intutic_notification_rule" "incidents_to_slack" {
  event_type         = "incident.created"
  channel            = "slack"
  slack_channel_name = "#agent-incidents"
  filter_severity    = ["critical", "high"]
}

resource "intutic_notification_rule" "incidents_to_pagerduty" {
  event_type            = "incident.created"
  channel               = "pagerduty"
  pagerduty_routing_key = var.pagerduty_routing_key
  filter_severity       = ["critical"]
  cooldown_minutes      = 60
}

variable "pagerduty_routing_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# A webhook rule whose signing secret is replaced every 30 days. The receiver
# reads the new secret from the output after each apply.
resource "time_rotating" "webhook" {
  rotation_days = 30
}

resource "intutic_notification_rule" "incidents_to_webhook" {
  event_type  = "incident.created"
  channel     = "webhook"
  webhook_url = "https://hooks.example.com/intutic"

  secret_rotation_triggers = {
    rotated = time_rotating.webhook.id
  }
}

output "incident_webhook_signing_secret" {
  value     = intutic_notification_rule.incidents_to_webhook.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) One of `slack`, `email`, `webhook`, `pagerduty`.
- `event_type` (String) The event that triggers the rule, for example `incident.created`.

### Optional

- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minimum minutes between notifications from this rule (1–1440). Defaults to 15.
- `email_recipients` (List of String) For `email`: 1–20 addresses, one message each.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `filter_harness_type` (List of String) Only notify for events whose harness type is one of these.
- `filter_severity` (List of String) Only notify for events whose severity is one of these.
- `filter_user_id` (List of String) Only notify for events whose user id is one of these.
- `pagerduty_routing_key` (String, Sensitive) For `pagerduty`: the integration's routing key. The API only ever returns it masked.
- `secret_rotation_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that rotate the signing secret when they change. Changing, adding or removing any value replaces a `webhook` rule's signing secret in place on the next apply and stores the new one in `signing_secret`; the old secret stops working at once. Creating the resource does not rotate, since the API issues a secret then. Only for a `webhook` rule.
- `slack_channel_id` (String) For `slack`: the channel id.
- `slack_channel_name` (String) For `slack`: the channel name.
- `webhook_url` (String) For `webhook`: an https URL on a public address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule id (`nr_…`).
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) For `webhook`: the secret that signs each delivery. Generated when the rule becomes a webhook or `secret_rotation_triggers` changes; null after an import, since the API returns it only once.

## Import

```shell
# Import by rule id. Webhook signing secrets and PagerDuty routing keys are
# never returned after creation.
terraform import intutic_notification_rule.incidents_to_slack nr_0123456789abcdef
```
